mostWorthwhile.text: Following ADH to the kidney was the strongest moment: it connected a bloodborne signal to water recovery and less water in urine.

surprise.text: The separate construction of the brain-to-blood route came after ADH had already been released; it clarified the route but made the sequence feel somewhat backwards.

arbitrary.text: The nerve endings and pituitary vessels had a clear purpose once explained, but building them after the signal had already travelled felt somewhat arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it offered more meaningful choices. The biology was clear, but most choices here simply followed a known pathway or the only available combination.
